issue.title: Fork CI reconciler: scope the cached green-trust decision to the pull request and its base
issue.body:
When a fork run turns green, the reconciler (AIP-120, #74822) checks once whether the pull request changes CI-defining files. It records the result as the `Fork CI / Tests (AMD)` commit status (`green` or `green_unverified`) and reuses it while that status is newer than the last retarget. A commit status belongs to the commit, so every open pull request with that head commit shares it, and their changed files can differ by base. A `green` decision made for one can mark another one ready without checking its files, which bypasses the CI-file check. The opposite case leaves a clean pull request `green_unverified`.

Proposed: key the decision by pull request and base, for example by making the status context or description specific to the base, or by recomputing when more than one open gated pull request has the same head commit. Add a test with one head commit shared by two pull requests with different bases.

Code: the green-trust block in `classify` in `dev/breeze/src/airflow_breeze/utils/fork_ci_reconcile.py`.
